description:
[read-only] Two or more campaigns side by side (`ids` comma-separated, e.g. organic vs organic, organic vs paid, or a campaign against its previous one): the same totals, per-network split, best/worst posts, and cumulative series by day since each start so they overlay. Unknown ids come back in `missing`.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/campaigns/compare.)

ids.description: Comma-separated campaign ids (at least two, at most `compareMax`).

name: compare_campaigns
title: Compare campaigns side by side
